injuries.shortComment: Haulcy (ankle) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Cowboys, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Haulcy appeared on Friday's injury report with an ankle injury. The strong safety initially entered the weekend listed as questionable but has now been downgraded to out ahead of Sunday's contest. Second-year safety Hunter Wohler is set to start at safety alongside Cam Bynum against the Cowboys.

injuries.shortComment: Gould (concussion) does not have a designation for Sunday's matchup versus Dallas.
injuries.longComment: Gould missed Indianapolis' previous two games while in concussion protocol. However, he was a full practice participant throughout this week and has been cleared to suit up by an independent neurologist. Gould likely will return to his usual specialist role as a kickoff and punt returner, though he probably won't be involved much in the passing game given that he's logged just one offensive snap through six games this season.

injuries.shortComment: Ogletree (knee) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus the Cowboys.
injuries.longComment: Ogletree was able to play through his nagging knee issue in Week 8 at Jacksonville, and he'll be active again in Week 9 despite missing practice Wednesday and logging a limited practice session Thursday. He figures to continue to compete with Mo Alie-Cox and Will Mallory for snaps at tight end behind clear frontrunner Tyler Warren.

injuries.shortComment: Boettcher (groin) was a full participant at the Colts' practice Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Boettcher appears to be on track to return to action Sunday versus the Cowboys after missing the team's last two contests with a groin issue. The 24-year-old will likely be back in his starting role at strongside linebacker against Dallas.

injuries.shortComment: When asked Wednesday when Pierce (heel) might be able to return to practice, Colts head coach Shane Steichen noted that he "can't put a timetable on it right now," Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.
injuries.longComment: Steichen said that Pierce, who has been on IR since Sept. 26, is currently rehabbing his injury, but the wideout's return is clearly not imminent. At 2-6, the Colts, who are already sellers ahead of the NFL trade deadline, have little incentive to rush Pierce back. Meanwhile, fellow WR Josh Downs has asked to be dealt, a situation that further clouds the team's pass-catching corps ahead of Week 9.

injuries.shortComment: Treadwell caught one of two targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: Treadwell failed to record multiple receptions in a game for the first time since Week 3 against Houston. The wide receiver could be set to operate in a more prominent role if the team decides to deal fellow wideout Josh Downs prior to the trade deadline Nov. 10. For the time being, Treadwell doesn't figure to have much fantasy appeal Sunday against the Cowboys.

injuries.shortComment: Adebawore agreed Tuesday with the Colts on a two-year, $35 million contract extension, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
injuries.longComment: Per Pelissero, the deal includes a $13 million signing bonus and $22.5 million in new money through next season. A 2023 fourth-round draft pick, Adebawore had been in the final year of his rookie deal and was considered a potential trade chip leading up to the Nov. 10 deadline, but the Colts have instead elected to keep him around on a longer-term basis. Through the Colts' first eight games of the season, 25-year-old defensive tackle has matched the career-best total of four sacks he posted over a 17-game slate in 2025. Adebawore has also added 19 tackles and two pass breakups.

injuries.shortComment: Giddens racked up 43 yards on six carries in Indianapolis' Week 8 loss to Jacksonville on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Giddens entered Sunday having not logged a snap this season, but he got an opportunity in the blowout loss and made the most of it, ripping off a pair of 12-yard runs on the way to a team-leading 43 rushing yards. However, it must be noted that he didn't enter until the game was far out of reach in the fourth quarter, so all of his production came in garbage time. Still, it was a meaningful performance by Giddens in the context of Indianapolis fielding trade offers for star RB Jonathan Taylor amidst a lost season. Should Taylor indeed be dealt, Giddens would immediately take on a more prominent role in the Colts backfield along with seventh-round rookie Seth McGowan.

injuries.shortComment: Oluokun recorded seven tackles (six solo), including 1.0 sacks, in Thursday's 33-10 victory over Baltimore.
injuries.longComment: Oluokun tied for his team's lead in stops and notched his second sack of the season when he brought down Joe Fagnano early in the second quarter. Oluokun has been a reliable fantasy IDP asset in 2026 with at least seven tackles in six of his eight games so far. He's tallied 58 total stops, including the 2.0 sacks, along with two interceptions and a forced fumble.

injuries.shortComment: Koziol finished Thursday's 33-10 win over Baltimore with two catches for 15 yards on two targets.
injuries.longComment: Koziol was part of a three-tight-end starting unit for Jacksonville alongside Brenton Strange and Nate Boerkircher. Koziol logged the fewest offensive snaps (12) among the trio but matched both in receptions. He entered Thursday with just one catch through five contests, so it's probably not wise to count on him for substantial production moving forward.

injuries.shortComment: Boerkircher hauled in two of three targets for 61 yards in Thursday night's 33-10 win over Baltimore.
injuries.longComment: Boerkircher was tied with Parker Washington for the second-most receiving yards on the team with 61. This game marks the fourth time this season that the rookie has surpassed 30 snaps on offense. Boerkircher has made a name for himself as Jacksonville's No. 2 option at tight end behind Brenton Strange.

injuries.shortComment: Cameron caught his only target for six yards in Thursday night's 33-10 victory over the Ravens.
injuries.longComment: Cameron didn't see the ball until the fourth quarter despite playing the third most snaps at wide receiver (25) for the Jaguars on Thursday, behind only Parker Washington (38) and Jakobi Meyers (38). This marks the third game in a row during which the 23-year-old played as the Jaguars' No. 3 option at receiver, but his limited usage keeps him as a low-priority waiver-wire add.

injuries.shortComment: Abdullah carried the ball seven times for 30 yards and returned one kickoff for 24 yards in Thursday night's 33-10 win over the Ravens.
injuries.longComment: Abdullah recorded the third-most-offensive snaps in the backfield (seven), behind Chris Rodriguez (25) and Bayshul Tuten (20). Should everyone in the backfield remain healthy, Abdullah will likely see a similar workload for the rest of the season.

injuries.shortComment: Strange caught both of his targets for 22 yards in Thursday night's 33-10 win over the Ravens.
injuries.longComment: The Jaguars keep blowing teams out and aren't being pushed on offense, which is keeping Trevor Lawrence's pass volume low. Strange is still making the most of his few opportunities, totaling four grabs for 77 yards on four targets over the last two weeks, games in which the Jaguars have combined to outscore their opponents 75-17. Strange is a TE1 for fantasy and gets a date with the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 15.

injuries.shortComment: Hunter caught his only target for minus-1 yard and lost a fumble in Thursday night's 33-10 win over the Ravens.
injuries.longComment: Hunter played six offensive snaps against Baltimore but turned the ball over on his only touch. After posting a 4-59-1 receiving line against the Texans in London back in Week 6, Hunter has done very little on offense. He needs the Jaguars' opponents to make games closer so the coaching staff feels obligated to utilize Hunter's big-play ability.

injuries.shortComment: Thomas wasn't targeted in Thursday night's 33-10 win over the Ravens.
injuries.longComment: Thomas played just 19 of 56 offensive snaps and ran only 11 routes on Trevor Lawrence's 26 dropbacks. It's become clear that Thomas is no longer a big part of the offense and needs an injury ahead of him or a trade out of Jacksonville to become relevant in season-long fantasy. He has just one catch for a 12-yard touchdown over his last four games.

injuries.shortComment: Rodriguez rushed 10 times for 19 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for 13 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Rodriguez finished with just two fewer carries than Bhayshul Tuten, who came into the game managing ankle and foot injuries and was able to log a relatively abbreviated workload thanks to game script. Both backs had plenty of trouble against Baltimore's stout run defense, but Rodriguez salvaged his fantasy night with a two-yard TD run just past the midway point of the fourth quarter. Rodriguez now has scored in back-to-back games heading into a Week 10 road matchup against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 15.

injuries.shortComment: Little made all four of his field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point tries in a 33-10 win over Baltimore on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: The Jaguars dominated in the victory, but they fell short of the end zone enough times to keep Little busy. He didn't need to fully flex the strength of his leg, as his longest kick was from a modest 47 yards out, but Little extended his run of consecutive successful FG attempts to 10. He's now gone 14-of-16 on field-goal tries this season while converting 25 of 26 point-after attempts.

injuries.shortComment: Meyers brought in four of six targets for 65 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Meyers set the pace for the Jaguars in both receptions and receiving yards on the night, bouncing back nicely from a quiet 2-24-0 line just four days earlier in a blowout win over the Colts. The veteran wideout has multiple catches in all but one game, although Meyers hasn't topped 83 receiving yards in any contest to date in 2026. Meyers remains a key target for Trevor Lawrence, but he could see at least a slight boost in his outlook heading into a Week 10 road matchup against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 15, if Brian Thomas is moved at the trade deadline.

injuries.shortComment: Lawrence completed 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while rushing once for minus-1 yard in the Jaguars' 33-16 win over the Ravens on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Lawrence unsurprisingly didn't have a high-volume night, as the Jaguars were progressively able to take control of the game with Joe Fagnano under center for the Ravens. The veteran signal-caller hit Parker Washington on a 50-yard catch-and-run touchdown over the middle just before halftime for his one scoring pass, and Lawrence connected with eight different targets overall on the night. The 2021 first overall pick has now thrown for 1,932 yards with an 18:4 TD:INT and added 79 yards on the ground heading into a Week 10 road matchup against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 15.

injuries.shortComment: Washington secured two of seven targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday night. He also returned one punt for 11 yards.
injuries.longComment: Washington led the Jaguars in targets while tying for second in receptions and receiving yards on the night. The fourth-year receiver snapped a two-game touchdown drought, crossing the goal line from 50 yards out on a catch and run over the middle with under a minute remaining in the first half. Washington has eclipsed 60 receiving yards in three of the past four games heading into a Week 10 road matchup against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 15.

injuries.shortComment: Tuten (ankle/foot) rushed 12 times for 29 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Tuten fought through the pair of lower-body injuries that made him a game-time decision, recording his fourth rushing touchdown of the campaign on a one-yard run to cap off the opening possession of the contest. The second-year back had to grind for every yard he got on the ground, but fortunately for Tuten, the Jaguars built a comfortable enough lead where he was able to benefit from an early end to his night. Tuten has now scored in back-to-back games, and he'll have some extra time to get healthier ahead of a Week 10 road matchup against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 15.

injuries.shortComment: Walker (ribs) is available for Thursday's game against Baltimore.
injuries.longComment: After carrying a questionable designation ahead of this contest, Walker will suit up versus the Ravens in Week 9. The 25-year-old hasn't missed a game this season, accumulating 18 total tackles (seven solo), including 3.0 sacks, in seven regular-season appearances.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson (ankle) has no injury designation ahead of Thursday night's matchup against Baltimore.
injuries.longComment: Johnson was forced to miss the team's Week 8 win over the Colts while nursing an ankle injury, but he appears to be good to go for Week 9. The 25-year-old was a limited participant at the team's final practice of the week Wednesday, so he may not be back to 100 percent, but Johnson should be back in his starting role at free safety versus the Ravens.

injuries.shortComment: Lane recorded four total tackles (one solo) and three passes defensed, including a pick-six, during Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
injuries.longComment: Lane played every one of the team's defensive snaps in Week 8, stepping into a starting role in the secondary with Antonio Johnson (ankle) unavailable. The 23-year-old's biggest moment of the game came in the second quarter when he jumped in front of a pass from Colts quarterback Daniel Jones for an interception, returning it 92 yards for his first career defensive touchdown. Lane has now compiled 20 total tackles (10 solo) and four passes defensed, including Sunday's pick-six, over seven contests during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: The Jaguars placed Murray (elbow) on their injured reserve list Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: It was already known Murray suffered a season-ending elbow injury during the first quarter of Sunday's game versus the Colts, so the move comes as no big surprise. In his absence, 2025 sixth-rounder Rayuan Lane could step into a starting role at safety for the rest of the year.

injuries.shortComment: Mahomes (elbow) underwent an MRI after Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets, and the tests did not reveal a major injury, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
injuries.longComment: Mahomes returned to Sunday's win after hurting his elbow late in the first half, and the initial MRI result offers some early optimism regarding the star quarterback's status for Week 10 against the Falcons. His participation level in practice will bear monitoring over the coming days, but all signs point to Mahomes having avoided a significant injury.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson rushed six times for 34 yards and a touchdown and returned one kickoff for 29 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: The Chiefs held a 28-12 lead by the end of three quarters, which provided the opportunity for head coach Andy Reid to give Kenneth Walker, who scored three total touchdowns, some down time in the latter portion of the contest. Johnson took advantage of his opportunities, recording a six-yard touchdown run with 3:35 remaining. The rookie fifth-round pick's yardage total was a new career high, while his carry tally was his highest since Week 3. Johnson will remain in a modest No. 2 role for a Week 10 road matchup against the Falcons next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Rice secured five of seven targets for 49 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Rice led the Chiefs in targets while finishing as the runner-up in both receptions and receiving yards. The veteran receiver has been busy the last two games while turning 15 targets into a 12-102-1 line, but he has just one catch of 20-plus yards in that span. Rice is averaging a relatively modest 11.7 yards per catch heading into a Week 10 road matchup against the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Kelce brought in four of six targets for 72 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday. He also rushed once for one yard.
injuries.longComment: Kelce led the Chiefs in receiving yards and finished second in targets on the afternoon, and his tally in the former category also served as the legendary tight end's second highest of the season. Kelce got there with a big boost from a game-high 38-yard catch, and he'll take a formidable 33-482-2 line into a Week 10 road matchup against the Falcons next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Butker missed his only field-goal attempt and made all five of his PATs during Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Butker pushed his only field-goal try wide right from 51 yards out in the final moments of the first half. The kicker has now gone 12-for-19 on field-goal attempts this season, and head coach Andy Reid was asked about Butker's future following the game, stating that he'll "address that" as the team prepares for Week 10, per Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star. The team signed veteran Justin Tucker to the practice squad in late October, and Tucker could get a shot with the active roster in Butker's place.

injuries.shortComment: Walker rushed 18 times for 102 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 41 yards and two more scores in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Walker put together another one of his signature high-efficiency performances on the ground, averaging 5.7 yards per carry in the process. He contributed a seven-yard touchdown reception on the first play of the second quarter, and he struck again as a receiver via a 25-yard scoring grab with just over five minutes remaining in the first half. Walker capped off the highly fantasy-friendly day with his seventh rushing touchdown of the season, a two-yard run in the waning moments of the third quarter. Walker is up to 872 rushing yards, 172 receiving yards and 11 total touchdowns heading into a Week 10 road matchup against the Falcons next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Worthy (hamstring) won't return to Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com previously noted that Worthy immediately grabbed his hamstring and was unable to put weight on his leg after sustaining his injury Sunday. That Worthy was so quickly ruled out for the remainder of the contest is certainly concerning in terms of his status for next week's game against the Falcons. In his absence versus the Jets, Cyrus Allen, Jalen Royals, Andrew Armstrong and Nikko Remigio are available to work behind top WR Rashee Rice.

injuries.shortComment: Moore (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Moore exited the second half of Sunday's game with an ankle injury. While the 28-year-old undergoes further evaluation, Joshua Ezeudu will return to play left tackle for the Chiefs' offense.

injuries.shortComment: Nussmeier is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jets but will serve as the Chiefs' emergency third quarterback.
injuries.longComment: It's a familiar role for the rookie seventh-round pick, who has served as the emergency No. 3 QB regularly this year. Nussmeier won't be able to see the field unless both Patrick Mahomes and Justin Fields exit due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuries.shortComment: Remigio is officially active for Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: The 27-year-old was questionable due to a hip issue, but it's no surprise he's suiting up after putting in full practice sessions Thursday and Friday. Remigio has played just two offensive snaps this year but has operated as Kansas City's primary return man and should continue to do so Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Allen caught two of three targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: The rookie wide receiver usurped Jalen Royals on the depth chart, operating as the clear WR3 behind Rashee Rice and Xavier Worthy. Allen ran 22 routes on Patrick Mahomes' 44 dropbacks, but with both Rice and Worthy healthy alongside Travis Kelce and Kenneth Walker, there doesn't appear to be much juice to squeeze for Allen.

injuries.shortComment: Gray caught both of his targets for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: The Chiefs' TE2 caught a four-yard score in the third quarter, his first touchdown of the season. Kansas City uses plenty of 12 personnel, deploying both Travis Kelce and Gray on offense, but Gray handles more of the blocking duties. On the season, he has 14 grabs for 173 yards and a touchdown. There isn't much meat on the bone here for fantasy purposes.

injuries.shortComment: The Chiefs placed Sneed (knee) on injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Sneed was initially given the questionable tag for Sunday's game against the Broncos. He's been able to play through a lingering knee issue, but his placement on IR indicates that the injury has gotten to the point that an extended absence is warranted for the seventh-year defensive back. Sneed will be required to miss at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 12 against the Bills on Thursday, Nov. 26. Jaden Hicks, Jadon Canady, Kristian Fulton and Christian Roland-Wallace are all candidates to see more work in the secondary due to the absences of both Sneed and Mansoor Delane (shoulder) for Sunday's AFC West tilt.

injuries.shortComment: The Chiefs designated Norman-Lott (knee) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Norman-Lott was limited in his return to practice Wednesday. He's in the final stages of his recovery from a torn ACL that he sustained in October of 2025. The Chiefs now have 21 days to activate Norman-Lott from the PUP list, otherwise he would be forced to miss the entire 2026 season.

injuries.shortComment: Conner finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to Seattle with seven tackles (two solo).
injuries.longComment: Conner was on the field for every single defensive snap for a second consecutive game following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye. He missed the first three games of the regular season due to a knee injury but has suited up for each of the team's last three contests, during which he has accumulated 17 tackles (nine solo), including 1.0 sacks, and one pass defense.

injuries.shortComment: Williams finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks with 10 tackles (four solo) and one interception.
injuries.longComment: The second-year defensive back's 10 tackles were a career best, and his interception off Sam Darnold late in the second quarter was also the first of Williams' NFL career. Williams is up to 29 tackles (17 solo), including 1.0 sacks, and seven pass defenses (including one interception) through six regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Bolton registered 11 tackles (six solo) during the Chiefs' 20-3 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Bolton played all but one of the Chiefs' 69 defensive snaps during Sunday's loss, and he finished second on the team in tackles behind Drue Tranquill (12). Bolton has recorded double-digit stops in four of six regular-season games and is up to 59 tackles (29 solo) and two pass defenses on the year.

injuries.shortComment: Tranquill finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks with 12 tackles (four solo).
injuries.longComment: Tranquil led the Chiefs in combined tackles Sunday, and he was one of three Kansas City defenders to reach double-digit stops. He's logged at least seven tackles in each of the first six games of the regular season and is up to 48 tackles (22 solo), two pass defenses and one fumble recovery in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Nailor caught two of four targets for nine yards during Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: Nailor was a non-factor on offense in Week 9, failing to reach double-digit receiving yards for the fourth time this season. The wide receiver has had a hard time getting into a groove in his first season with Las Vegas, catching 14 of 28 targets for 122 yards and a touchdown over eight contests so far.

injuries.shortComment: Mayer caught all three of his targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: The tight end was inches and a couple breaks away from having a much bigger afternoon, as he lost a fumble just before crossing the goal line on what would have been a 25-yard touchdown. He then had another score called back on a penalty in the second half. Mayer has alternated big games with down ones this season, and he'll try to rebound next Sunday in a tough spot against the Seahawks' strong defense.

injuries.shortComment: Washington turned six carries into minus-three yards in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: The rookie running back wasn't targeted in the passing game. One week after getting a trial run as the Raiders' clear lead back, a game in which he failed to produce with 25 carries, Washington was out-snapped 32 to 17 by Ashton Jeanty against San Francisco. Washington has done nothing to suggest he's warranted more carries for Las Vegas. He's averaging just 3.9 yards per carry on 71 totes this season and has shown nothing as a pass catcher. Washington is nothing more than a fantasy bench stash, but the Raiders' rushing attack seems broken as a whole.

injuries.shortComment: Tucker caught four of eight targets for 55 yards during Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: Tucker finished tied for the team lead in targets with tight end Brock Bowers, garnering at least five targets for the fourth time in the fifth time in the team's last six contests. The wide receiver rebounded well after being blanked in Week 8 versus the Jets, securing four or more receptions for the seventh time this season. Tucker has now reeled in 33 of 56 targets for 529 yards and four touchdowns over the Raiders' first nine games during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Jeanty rushed six times for 25 yards while catching five of seven targets for minus-5 yards in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: The Raiders largely abandoned the run after falling down 14-0 early, but Jeanty was more effective with his six carries than Mike Washington, who rushed six times for minus-3 yards and finished without a target. Sunday's even distribution in carries was a positive development for Jeanty, who had just two rushing attempts to Washington's 25 in the Week 8 win over the Jets. Jeanty still has more receiving yards (371) than rushing yards (362) and is averaging just 3.2 yards per carry heading into a difficult Week 10 matchup against Seattle's elite front seven.

injuries.shortComment: Cousins completed 22 of 32 passes for 216 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed twice for no gain and scored a rushing touchdown.
injuries.longComment: Cousins made numerous costly mistakes as the Raiders tried in vain to catch up after falling in an early 14-0 hole. He threw a pick-six on the first play of the second half and capped both of Vegas' fourth-quarter possessions with end-zone interceptions. The 38-year-old Cousins has staved off calls for rookie first overall pick Fernando Mendoza to take over the starting role by producing 21 total TDs through nine starts, including a two-yard rushing touchdown in the second quarter and 21-yard touchdown pass to Brock Bowers in the third quarter Sunday. The Raiders have gone 1-5 after a 3-0 start, and the calls for Mendoza could grow louder if Vegas' struggles persist in Week 10 against the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Bowers caught seven of eight targets for 111 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed once for two yards and lost a fumble.
injuries.longComment: Bowers had a 21-yard touchdown reception in the third quarter and came one yard short of scoring again on a 33-yard catch on a fourth-quarter drive that ended with a Kirk Cousins interception in the end zone. The star TE has reached 70 receiving yards in all seven of his appearances this season and is up to six touchdowns. Bowers came five receiving yards shy of his season high and continues to roll, even as the 4-5 Raiders drop out of contention in the AFC. He'll likely face more resistance in Week 10 against the Seahawks, who just held Cardinals TE Trey McBride to 54 yards.

injuries.shortComment: Zuhn (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Las Vegas' matchup versus the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Zuhn is done for the day after sustaining a concussion in the third quarter. Caleb Rogers has taken over at right guard in his absence, and Zuhn will now have to clear the league's concussion protocol before he can return to the field.

injuries.shortComment: Thornton (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: Thornton recovered from a back injury Friday and entered the weekend with no injury designation. The wide receiver's inactive status, despite his health, points to some other motive from coach Klint Kubiak. Dareke Young is set to be the No. 4 wide receiver in Thornton's place.

injuries.shortComment: Porter (groin) is active for Sunday's Week 9 battle against the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: Porter suffered a groin injury last Sunday against the Jets and logged a DNP/LP/FP practice progression this week. He was questionable to suit up entering Sunday but will ultimately be able to give it a go. Porter ranks second on the Raiders with five defensed passes on the season.

injuries.shortComment: Benson (coach's decision) is a healthy scratch for Sunday's battle against San Francisco.
injuries.longComment: It's the second straight week the rookie wideout is a healthy scratch. Benson hasn't been able to gain much traction in the offense this season, as he's notched just two catches for 12 yards on nine targets through seven games. He's also contributed as a punt returner, and Dylan Laube could assume that role in Benson's absence Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive and serving as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback Sunday versus San Francisco.
injuries.longComment: O'Connell has regularly been Las Vegas' emergency QB this season and has yet to log any game action. He won't be able to enter Sunday's matchup unless both Kirk Cousins and Fernando Mendoza have to exit due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuries.shortComment: Dean recorded 12 total tackles (two solo) during Sunday's 38-33 victory against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Dean was able to notch exactly 12 stops for the fourth game in a row and fifth time this season. The linebacker is out to a great start to his first campaign in Las Vegas, registering 80 total tackles (38 solo), including 1.5 sacks, while also adding an interception and three forced fumbles over eight contests so far.

injuries.shortComment: Chinn recorded 10 total tackles (four solo) and an interception during Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Chinn had quite a day in Week 8, finishing second on the team in takedowns while also jumping in front of a deep ball from Jets quarterback Geno Smith for the safety's first interception of the year. Chinn has now compiled 56 total tackles (38 solo), including 1.0 sacks, while also adding two forced fumbles, two fumble recoveries and an interception over eight contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: White was signed by the Raiders on Thursday, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: White was released by the team Tuesday to make room for Carter Runyon (foot), who was activated off injured reserve. With Runyon now waived and potentially joining the Raiders' practice squad, White was re-signed. To date, the 27-year-old has had the best season of his career, amassing eight catches (19 targets) for 112 yards and three touchdowns.

injuries.shortComment: Bech finished without a target or touch in Sunday's 38-33 Week 8 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Bech returned from a four-game absence due to a forearm injury and logged a 40 percent offensive snap share, but he didn't get any looks from QB Kirk Cousins. In fact, Cousins didn't go to his wideout corps as a whole very often -- 16 of his 26 targets went to tight ends, and another four went to running back Ashton Jeanty. Bech will look to get back into the box score Sunday in a Week 9 matchup in San Francisco.

injuries.shortComment: Mendoza didn't play in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: With Kirk Cousins helping orchestrate a second-half comeback, Mendoza stayed glued to the sideline for the third straight contest after playing 10 offensive snaps in Week 5 against New England. The Raiders are 4-4 with Cousins playing reasonably well to keep the team in the postseason mix. Mendoza figures to get his shot if/when the Raiders are eliminated from postseason contention.

injuries.shortComment: Gay converted his sole field-goal attempt and all five PATs in the Raiders' 38-33 win over the Jets on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Gay converted a 53-yard field goal with 27 seconds remaining in the contest to put the Raiders up five points. The kicker is now 18-for-20 on field-goal attempts and a perfect 19-for-19 on PATs over eight regular-season games in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Uiagalelei completed two of seven passes for 27 yards and a touchdown after replacing Justin Herbert (finger) in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans, and head coach Jim Harbaugh said after the game that Herbert could have a fractured finger, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Uiagalelei was inaccurate in his first taste of regular-season NFL action but threw a 15-yard touchdown pass to Derius Davis. If Herbert isn't available to face the Ravens on MNF in Week 10 and Trey Lance (groin) isn't ready to return from injured reserve, Uiagalelei would presumably be tabbed for the first regular-season start of the latter's career.

injuries.shortComment: Johnston caught one of four targets for a 58-yard touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Johnston's long touchdown catch cut the deficit to 38-15 in the fourth quarter. That was the final pass Justin Herbert (finger) completed before exiting the game. If Herbert can't play against the Ravens in Week 10, Johnston would likely find himself catching passes from DJ Uiagalelei. Johnston's 58 receiving yards set a new season high, surpassing his one-catch, 57-yard effort in Week 6, and Sunday's TD was his first of the season.

injuries.shortComment: Mitchell rushed seven times for 33 yards and caught three of four targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans. He also lost a fumble.
injuries.longComment: Mitchell led LA's three-man backfield rotation with 67 scrimmage yards while Omarion Hampton had 60 and Kimani Vidal contributed 36. Mitchell's fumble came late in the third quarter, with the Chargers already trailing 31-9 at the time. The winless Chargers are averaging a league-low 15.1 points per game heading into a Week 10 trip to Baltimore, and things could get even worse if QB Justin Herbert (finger) has to miss time after getting injured in the fourth quarter.

injuries.shortComment: Hampton rushed 13 times for 60 yards and wasn't targeted in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Hampton worked as the Chargers' primary rushing option ahead of Keaton Mitchell and Kimani Vidal, who recorded seven carries apiece. The 0-8 Chargers unsurprisingly faced another negative game script, though, and Hampton wasn't involved in the passing game. The 2025 first-round pick continues to disappoint on a surprisingly awful offense that could get even worse should QB Justin Herbert (finger) miss any additional action after exiting in the fourth quarter. Hampton will try to snap a four-game touchdown drought in Week 10 against the Ravens.

injuries.shortComment: Davis caught one of two targets for a 15-yard touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans.
injuries.longComment: With Justin Herbert (finger) out of the game and the score out of hand already, Davis caught a 15-yard touchdown from backup DJ Uiagalelei in the fourth quarter. Davis has no fantasy value as a reserve wideout in one of the league's worst offenses.

injuries.shortComment: Herbert sustained a left middle finger injury in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Coach Jim Harbaugh said after the latest loss that Herbert "could" have a fracture. The quarterback was pulled from the game with the score out of hand in the fourth quarter, but Herbert apparently lobbied to stay in the contest. He'll have an extra day to heal up ahead of next Monday night's date with the Ravens. Herbert has been well off the fantasy radar for much of the season in this broken Los Angeles offense. If he can't face Baltimore, DJ Uiagalelei would likely get the nod under center. He completed a pitiful two of seven passes for 24 yards and a touchdown in relief of Herbert on Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Hart (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Hart exited the third quarter of Sunday's game with an ankle injury. Rodney Shelley will play outside cornerback opposite Donte Jackson while Hart undergoes further evaluation.

injuries.shortComment: Waxter (ankle) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: The special-teamer will not return to Sunday's contest after exiting in the first quarter. A number of players could step up to contribute on special teams in Waxter's absence.

injuries.shortComment: Eboigbe is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Houston due to an ankle injury, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Eboigbe was hurt in the first quarter, and his return is uncertain. Nick Barrett will likely pick up more defensive snaps for as long as Eboigbe remains sidelined.

injuries.shortComment: McConkey (back) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Prior to his first-quarter exit, McConkey wasn't targeted by QB Justin Herbert. His absence leaves Quentin Johnston, Tre' Harris, KeAndre Lambert-Smith and Derius Davis as the Chargers' available WRs versus Houston.

injuries.shortComment: Awosika (lower leg) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Awosika will miss yet another contest with a fibula injury he suffered in Week 2. Rookie guard Logan Taylor is set to make his fourth straight start in Sunday's contest.

injuries.shortComment: Thompson (quadriceps/hamstring) is inactive against Houston on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: This doesn't come as a surprise, as Thompson was doubtful heading into the contest after sitting out practice all week. The rookie wideout hasn't logged any game action since Week 2, and it's unclear if he'll be able to return next Monday in Baltimore. Thompson's continued absence will dent the depth of Los Angeles' wideout corps.

injuries.shortComment: Perryman (undisclosed) was not activated ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans, per the NFL's transaction log.
injuries.longComment: Perryman logged a pair of limited sessions during Week 9 prep but is not quite ready to return to the Chargers' 53-man roster. The inside linebacker will continue his recovery during Week 10 prep in the hopes of making his 2026 regular-season debut soon.

injuries.shortComment: Njoku (fibula) wasn't activated from IR-designated to return ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans, per the NFL's official transaction log.
injuries.longComment: Njoku returned to practice this week but was limited all three days before being deemed doubtful for Week 9 action. The TE's next chance to play will arrive Monday, Nov. 16, when the Chargers face the Ravens.

injuries.shortComment: Shelley (ankle) has no designation for Sunday's tilt against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Shelley missed each of Los Angeles' past three games while tending to an ankle injury. However, he followed two limited practices to begin this week with a full session Friday to position himself for a return Sunday. Shelley has played a rotational role in the secondary when active this season while also contributing on special teams.

injuries.shortComment: Jackson (hamstring) does not have a designation for Sunday's tilt against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Jackson missed each of the Chargers' past three games due to a hamstring injury, but he was able to log a full practice session Friday and is set to return to action versus Houston. Before getting hurt, he started in three of his four appearances to begin the season, so he'll likely return to that role Sunday, especially since fellow cornerback Deane Leonard (concussion) has been ruled out.

injuries.shortComment: Henley (shoulder) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.
injuries.longComment: Henley was dinged up in Sunday's loss to the Rams but was able to return to the contest, and it appears he'll all set for the Week 9 tilt against the Texans. Henley has posted 41 tackles (17 solo), including 0.5 sacks, two fumble recoveries, a forced fumble and one pass breakup across seven starts this season.

injuries.shortComment: Lambert-Smith did not garner a target during Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: Lambert-Smith was expected to revert back to a minimal role on offense in Week 8 due to both Ladd McConkey and Tre' Harris returning to action, and that is exactly what happened. Lambert-Smith played just two offensive snaps in the contest, and he will continue to have little to no fantasy value as long as the rest of the Chargers' primary pass catchers are healthy.

injuries.shortComment: Kolar caught one of four targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: The tight end's four targets tied for third on the team, as he ran 17 routes on Justin Herbert's 37 dropbacks against Los Angeles. More of a blocker than receiver, Kolar has been forced to catch more passes out of necessity at times this season. He has 10 grabs for 98 yards on 17 targets. The catches and targets are both career highs in his fifth season.

injuries.shortComment: Harris caught all three of his targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: After missing Week 6 with a hamstring injury, Harris was healthy coming out of the Week 7 bye but played pretty clearly behind both Ladd McConkey and Quentin Johnston against the Rams. Harris ran just 20 routes to McConkey's 34 and Johnston's 30. Harris would see a big boost if Johnston gets traded ahead of next week's deadline.

injuries.shortComment: Dicker made all three of his field-goal attempts during Sunday's 24-9 loss against the Rams. He did not kick any extra-point tries.
injuries.longComment: The Chargers offense put forth another poor effort in Week 8, with four of their 11 drives ending in punts and another three ending with turnovers. Dicker has mostly been efficient through his first seven games of the season, making 12 of his 14 field-goal attempts, but until the offense demonstrates it can consistently move the ball down the field, he'll be hard to trust as a fantasy option.

injuries.shortComment: Garrett recorded 3.0 sacks and forced a fumble in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: Making his return from a knee injury that had sidelined him since Week 1, Garrett made an immediate impact and accounted for three of the Rams' four sacks of Jayden Daniels on the afternoon, with Braden Fiske and Shaun Dolac splitting the other. A healthy Garrett's presence in the front seven changes the entire complexion of the defense, and he could continue to make up for lost time in Week 10 against Gardner Minshew and the Cardinals.

injuries.shortComment: Corum carried the ball 11 times for 58 yards and a touchdown and failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: The Rams' backfield has become a full-fledged timeshare, with Corum getting double-digit carries for a third straight game and out-producing Kyren Williams on the ground in Washington. Corum has gotten into the end zone in all three of those contests, punching in a one-yard score in the third quarter Sunday, and over that stretch he's amassed 224 rushing yards and three TDs while averaging 5.7 yards a carry. With Puka Nacua (knee) headed for an MRI, the Rams could lean even more heavily on their ground attack in a Week 10 tilt against the Cardinals.

injuries.shortComment: Stafford completed 26 of 43 passes for 228 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders. He added one yard on his only carry.
injuries.longComment: The veteran QB looked the way of Puka Nacua (knee) early and often, with no other Ram pass catcher managing more than 20 receiving yards, and the star wideout was on the other end of a seven-yard TD toss in the fourth quarter that proved to be the winning score. Stafford has thrown a single touchdown pass in back-to-back games after producing multiple TDs in five of six contests before that, and his options could get even thinner with Nacua headed for an MRI after getting hurt on L.A.'s final possession.

injuries.shortComment: Nacua suffered a knee injury during Sunday's 20-13 win at Washington and will undergo an MRI on Monday to determine its extent, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
injuries.longComment: The Rams already are without WR Davante Adams for a few more weeks after he underwent surgery on his left hamstring, and the team now may be sans Nacua if the results of Monday's testing go a certain way. L.A. doesn't believe that Nacua sustained a torn ACL, but the MRI will reveal what type of damage he incurred. Before picking up the injury on the Rams' final offensive snap, Nacua gathered in 14 of 19 targets for 150 yards and one touchdown and took two carries for 20 yards.

injuries.shortComment: Williams carried the ball 15 times for 45 yards and caught three of four targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 20-13 win over Washington.
injuries.longComment: Blake Corum was the more productive Ram on the ground, turning 11 carries into 58 yards and a touchdown, but the offense mainly flowed through Puka Nacua on the afternoon. Williams failed to find the end zone for only the third time in nine games this season, and the 45 rushing yards were his lowest total since Week 1, although he has yet to reach 100 in any contest. The Los Angeles backfield has become a clear timeshare however, limiting Williams' upside heading into a Week 10 trip to Arizona.

injuries.shortComment: Coach Sean McVay noted Sunday that Ferguson pulled his hamstring during Friday's practice and will likely be sidelined for another couple of weeks, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Ferguson, who had previously been out with an ankle injury, was designated to return from IR on Wednesday and on the verge of a return to the Rams' lineup prior to Friday's setback. With that in mind, McVay said that the tight end was going to be a "big part" of the game plan Sunday against the Commanders. Instead, Tyler Higbee (one catch for 13 yards on five targets) and Colby Parkinson (four catches on any many targets for 13) yards) were the team's primary pass-catching options at the TE position in Week 9.

injuries.shortComment: Avila (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's matchup against the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: Avila dealt with a hamstring issue throughout the week and apparently aggravated the injury in the first half Sunday. Now that he's been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday, Beaux Limmer is slated to finish the contest at left guard.

injuries.shortComment: Stuard is listed as active for Sunday's matchup against the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: Stuard finished the week as a limited participant in Friday's practice due to a hamstring injury that occurred during Week 8 warmups. The 28-year-old has played in all eight Rams games this season, recording two total tackles (one solo).

injuries.shortComment: Cardona (ankle) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: Cardona continues to struggle with an ankle injury and will now miss a second straight week. Jake McQuaide will once again operate as the Rams' long snapper in Sunday's contest.

injuries.shortComment: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback in Sunday's game against the Commanders, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Simpson will once again be inactive behind quarterbacks Matthew Stafford and Stetson Bennett. The first-round rookie will only be eligible to play if both Stafford and Bennett exit the contest due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuries.shortComment: Curl (foot) is active for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: Curl is set to suit up for Sunday's game despite missing the Rams' Wednesday and Thursday practice sessions. The strong safety will need to anchor the team's secondary due to the absence of starting cornerbacks Jaylen Watson (shoulder, IR) and Trent McDuffie (back).

injuries.shortComment: McDuffie (back) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: McDuffie will miss his third game of the season due to injury. The star cornerback played 80 percent of the defensive snaps in the Rams' Week 8 win over the Chargers but picked up a back injury during the victory. With Jaylen Watson (shoulder) on IR, the Rams' starting corners against the Commanders will likely be Josh Wallace and Emmanuel Forbes.

injuries.shortComment: Parkinson (ribs) is listed as active for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: Parkinson, who was inactive in Week 8, managed to log a limited practice Friday, before being listed as questionable for the contest. With Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) -- who was initially slated to return to action this week but subsequently ruled out -- still not in the mix, the return of Parkinson, who has caught five passes in each of the last two games he played, is a welcome boost to a Rams TE corps that also includes Tyler Higbee, Davis Allen and Max Klare.

injuries.shortComment: Whittington (back) is active for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
injuries.longComment: Whittington was a limited participant throughout Week 9 prep as he dealt with a back injury. The kick returner and No. 4 wide receiver for the Rams is all set to suit up for Sunday's game as he looks to play through the issue.

injuries.shortComment: The Rams placed Watson (shoulder) on injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Watson exited Sunday's win over the Chargers early with a severe shoulder injury. The cornerback will undergo surgery while on IR, which will end his season. Watson ends the season with 24 tackles (14 solo) and nine passes defensed, including one interception, over seven regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: The Rams activated Rivers (calf) from injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Rivers missed six games while on injured reserve with a calf injury he sustained in the Rams' Week 2 loss to the Giants. The 27-year-old has returned ahead of Sunday's game against the Commanders and has no injury designation headed into the contest. Rivers will likely be a special-teams contributor with no real role in the Rams' offense.

injuries.shortComment: Lake recorded seven total tackles (two solo) and two passes defensed, including an interception, during Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Lake was able to secure exactly seven takedowns for the third straight week, as he has now registered six or more tackles in every game this season. The 27-year-old's biggest moment of the contest came in the first quarter, when he jumped in front of a short pass from Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert for his third interception of the year. Lake has now compiled 56 total tackles (34 solo), a forced fumble, and 11 passes defensed, three of which are interceptions, over eight games so far in the regular season.

injuries.shortComment: The Rams signed Karty to their active roster Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Karty was elevated from the practice squad for each of the Rams' previous two games and handled kickoff duties while Brandon McManus kicked field goals and extra points. That arrangement isn't expected to change moving forward, per Nate Adkins of The Athletic, so it would likely take a McManus slump or injury for Karty to get a shot at the fantasy-relevant aspects of the kicker position.

injuries.shortComment: Higbee caught one of two targets for 14 yards against the Chargers in Sunday's 24-9 victory.
injuries.longComment: Higbee logged a hearty 83 percent offensive snap share, most among Rams tight ends. However, he got little attention from quarterback Matthew Stafford, recording just two targets. Higbee had a nice run in Weeks 3-5, when he logged 18 catches for 212 yards across the three-game span. However, since then he's posted just seven receptions for 50 yards across his subsequent three contests. As such, it's hard to trust Higbee on a week-to-week basis right now even with the Rams down multiple pass catchers in Davante Adams (hamstring - IR), Terrance Ferguson (ankle - IR) and Colby Parkinson (ribs).

injuries.shortComment: Connors (hand) was placed on IR on Tuesday, Blaine Grisak of SI.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Connors broke his hand in Sunday's win over the Chargers and is slated for surgery. He's worked as a core special-teamer this season but hasn't logged a snap on offense. As such, Connors' IR stint -- which will last at least four games -- isn't likely to cause any waves in fantasy.

injuries.shortComment: McManus converted his sole field-goal attempt and all three PATs in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: While Joshua Karty handled kickoffs for the Rams, McManus was entrusted with field goals and extra-point tries. The kicker's first field-goal attempt with his new team was a 30-yarder, so the veteran player has not yet been challenged as a Ram.

injuries.shortComment: Dulcich caught two of four targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 19-9 loss to the Lions.
injuries.longComment: Entering play Sunday, Dulcich produced 13 grabs for 166 yards over his previous three games, but he took a big step back against Detroit on a day Malik Willis didn't have any answers, as he passed for just 128 yards. Dulcich doesn't catch touchdowns and plays in a low-volume, low-scoring offense, making him more of a TE2 headed into Week 10 against the Colts.

injuries.shortComment: Washington caught two of three targets for 21 yards during Sunday's 19-9 loss to the Lions.
injuries.longComment: Washington was held in check by Detroit's suspect secondary, failing to reel in at least three passes for the first time this season while his 21 receiving yards were also a season low. The wide receiver has yet to exceed 70 receiving yards in a game this year, and he has only reached the end zone once. Washington will have an opportunity to get back on track against the sputtering Colts in Week 10.

injuries.shortComment: Douglas secured six of eight targets for 70 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Douglas led the Dolphins in receptions, receiving yards and targets, as the rookie third-round pick continued to profile as one of Malik Willis' most reliable targets. Douglas' catch and target totals were also new career highs, while his yardage tally tied for the second highest of his nascent NFL tenure. Douglas should continue to play a key role in Miami's air attack over the second half of the season as the Dolphins look to continue cultivating their young talent.

injuries.shortComment: Willis completed 13 of 25 passes for 128 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and added two rushes for seven yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Willis was back under 200 passing yards for the first time in three games, and he failed to throw at least one touchdown pass for the first time since Week 4. The 2022 third-round pick connected with seven different targets overall, and following the game, Joe Schad of the Palm Beach Post reported that Willis was dealing with both groin tightness and a tight hamstring during the game. Willis and the Dolphins' Week 10 matchup is a Colts team that could trade away multiple key players before Tuesday's deadline.

injuries.shortComment: Gordon rushed 16 times for 55 yards and brought in his only target for nine yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Gordon worked in the lead role as expected but found running room at a premium against a game Lions defense. Gordon has at least Sunday's carry total in four straight games, but he's now seen his rushing yardage total decline in consecutive games. Jaylen Wright's inactive status due to a quadriceps injury helped Gordon's touch floor overall, and the latter should remain the top option in Miami's ground attack in a favorable Week 10 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Kacmarek is dealing with a quad injury and is questionable to return to Sunday's clash against Detroit.
injuries.longComment: Kacmarek took a low hit after making a catch in the third quarter and subsequently went to the medical tent. He then returned to the sideline and tested out the injured leg, so he appears to be at least attempting to re-enter the contest. If Kacmarek can't return, however, Greg Dulcich and Seydou Traore will be Miami's two healthy active tight ends.

injuries.shortComment: Herring (neck) is active for Sunday's game against the Lions.
injuries.longComment: Herring suffered a neck injury in the Week 8 loss to New England. Despite logging three limited practices throughout the week and being listed as questionable, he's good to go for the meeting with Detroit. The 28-year-old has appeared in seven regular-season games in 2026, accruing nine total tackles (four solo) and 1.0 sacks.

injuries.shortComment: Allen is listed as active for Sunday's matchup against the Lions.
injuries.longComment: Allen is officially active for Sunday's matchup against the Lions after finishing the week with full participation in practice Friday. The 23-year-old plays had been playing a majority of his snaps on special teams, but with Jaylen Wright (quad) inactive versus Detroit, Allen and Carlos Washington are the backs who would be in line pick up extra Week 9 carries if top RB Ollie Gordon were to leave the game for any reason.

injuries.shortComment: Wright (quadriceps) is listed as inactive Sunday against the Lions.
injuries.longComment: After sitting out Wednesday's practice due to a quadriceps injury, Wright was able to get back to limited Thursday and maintain that activity level Friday, at which point he was tagged as questionable in advance of the weekend. On Sunday morning, however, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported that Wright wasn't expected to suit up, and that's now locked in. With Wright out of the lineup, Kaytron Allen (quad) and Carlos Washington will serve as the reserve RB options behind Ollie Gordon.

injuries.shortComment: Miami elevated Washington from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's tilt against Detroit.
injuries.longComment: Washington's elevation is his second of the campaign. He was active for Week 5 and logged nine offensive snaps, along with three special-teams snaps, against Cincinnati, but he finished without any touches or targets. His workload against the Lions will likely depend on whether Jaylen Wright and Kaytron Allen, both of whom are questionable due to quad injuries, are able to suit up.

injuries.shortComment: The Dolphins elevated Gonzalez from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Gonzalez has worked as Miami's gameday kicker each of the past two weeks and will do so again versus Detroit on Sunday. He's performed adequately so far, going 2-for-3 on field-goal tries and 5-for-5 on extra-point attempts. This is Gonzalez's third and final elevation, so the Dolphins would need to sign him to the active roster to continue having him kick in games beyond this weekend.

injuries.shortComment: Proctor (concussion) does not have a designation for Sunday's Week 9 matchup versus Detroit, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
injuries.longComment: Proctor suffered a concussion in Week 7 against the Jets and didn't play this past Sunday versus New England. However, he was a full participant in all three of Miami's practices this week and has cleared concussion protocol. Proctor is therefore set to reclaim his starting role at left guard.

injuries.shortComment: Rodriguez notched eight tackles (two solo) and forced a fumble in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.
injuries.longComment: Rodriguez fell three tackles shy of Jordyn Brooks' team-leading total as the Dolphins dropped to 1-6. The rookie second-round pick's 12 tackles over the past two games mark the most fallow two-game stretch of Rodriguez's young career in that category. He'll try to pick up the pace in Week 9 against the Lions.

injuries.shortComment: Brooks recorded 11 tackles (six solo) in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.
injuries.longComment: Brooks led the Dolphins in tackles during the loss, which dropped Miami's record to 1-6. The 29-year-old linebacker has slowed down a bit after leading the NFL with 183 tackles (99 solo) during the 2025 regular season, though he's still averaging a respectable nine tackles per game in 2026. He could draw interest on the trade market from contending teams in search of help at linebacker.

injuries.shortComment: The Vikings are signing Beckham from the practice squad to the active roster, Tom Pelissero of NFL Network reports.
injuries.longComment: Beckham kicked off the season with the Giants but was targeted just one time through the first three contests before the team released him Sept. 29. He then joined the Vikings on the practice squad and was elevated for Week 5 but eventually was inactive. Thus, if Beckham is able to avoid such a listing Monday against the Bills, it'll mark the sixth different organization in which he's suited up in his career.

injuries.shortComment: Van Ginkel (chest) doesn't have a designation for Monday's matchup against the Bills, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Van Ginkel was limited in practice Wednesday and Thursday but was able to upgrade to full participation Saturday. He's thus clear to suit up on Monday Night Football against the Bills. That's a big deal for the Vikings in their quest to slow down Josh Allen, as Van Ginkel leads the team with 6.5 sacks through seven games.

injuries.shortComment: Claiborne (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's battle against Buffalo, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Claiborne didn't practice Friday or Saturday after suffering a knee injury in practice Wednesday. Head coach Kevin O'Connell said he doesn't think Claiborne will need surgery but added that the team is still evaluating the injury. The running back has played sparingly this season, logging 18 offensive snaps through four games and tallying 13 yards on six carries along with eight yards on two receptions.

injuries.shortComment: Jennings (calf) has been ruled out for Monday's contest versus the Bills.
injuries.longComment: Per head coach Kevin O'Connell, Jennings suffered a calf injury at Thursday's practice that is serious enough to sideline him for at least one game. Jennings' next chance for game action is Sunday, Nov. 15 in Green Bay, while Tai Felton and Myles Price are in for some offensive snaps this week behind the top WR duo of Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Saturday that Murray (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game versus the Bills.
injuries.longComment: Murray emerged from last Sunday's loss to the Lions with a sore hamstring, and O'Connell told Alec Lewis of The Athletic on Thursday that the quarterback was unlikely to play in Week 9 but also wasn't an IR consideration. Tom Pelissero of Netflix reported Saturday morning that Murray is in recovery mode from a Grade 2 hamstring strain that will sideline him Monday and potentially beyond that point. Now that Murray officially is out for his second contest of the campaign, Carson Wentz is set to see his first game action since Week 2.

injuries.shortComment: Darrisaw (shoulder) was a full practice participant Friday.
injuries.longComment: Darrisaw began Week 9 prep with a limited session Thursday, but he was able to log a full session Friday. As such, he should be good to go for Monday's matchup against Buffalo.

injuries.shortComment: Brosmer is set to back up Carson Wentz against the Bills on Monday, as Kyler Murray (hamstring) won't play, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: It would likely take an injury to Wentz for Brosmer to get into the game, but the latter moves one step closer to getting on the field for the first time in 2026. Brosmer didn't look like an NFL-caliber QB as a rookie in 2025, posting a 0:4 TD:INT across seven appearances, including two starts.

injuries.shortComment: Wentz is stated to start Monday night's game against the Bills, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
injuries.longComment: Wentz will get the Week 9 assignment at QB for the Vikings, with Kyler Murray viewed as week-to-week with a hamstring strain, per Ian Rapoport of NFL Network. Max Brosmer will be the team's backup versus Buffalo, and perhaps longer than that should Murray's injury linger. Wentz thus represents an option for those in Superflex formats or otherwise are in need of signal-caller help due to injury or bye week issues.

injuries.shortComment: Dallas was signed to the Vikings' active roster Wednesday, Craig Peters of the team's official website reports.
injuries.longComment: Dallas will return to the active roster after playing in the first five contests of the year with the Vikings before being released and ultimately returning to the team as a member of the practice squad in late October. The running back has rushed four times for 14 yards and caught all four of his targets for 34 yards over seven contests with Minnesota this year, and he figures to operate in an extreme depth role behind Aaron Jones and Jordan Mason on Monday night versus Buffalo.

injuries.shortComment: Wilson registered 11 tackles, including 1.0 sacks, in Sunday's loss to Detroit.
injuries.longComment: Wilson finished second on the Vikings in stops, behind only Josh Metellus (13). One of his tackles was a sack of Jared Goff for a 10-yard loss on Detroit's first drive of the game, resulting in a Detroit punt. Wilson has 3.0 sacks through seven games, so he could surpass the career-best mark of 6.5 sacks he recorded over 17 regular-season games last year.

injuries.shortComment: Metellus recorded 13 tackles (six solo) and a defensed pass in a Week 8 defeat against Detroit.
injuries.longComment: Metellus led Minnesota in tackles and recorded a season-high mark in the process. He's been a consistent presence for the Vikings' tough defense this season, playing every defensive snap in six of the team's seven contests so far. Metellus is up to 50 stops through seven games, putting him on pace for the third triple-digit tackle campaign of his career.

injuries.shortComment: Murphy registered 10 tackles (eight solo) in a loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Murphy tied for third on Minnesota in tackles on a day when four Vikings finished with double-digit stops. The tackle tally was Murphy's highest of the season and snapped a four-game stretch of posting three stops or fewer. The veteran cornerback is enjoying a nice campaign overall, as he's tallied three interceptions so far, tying for second in the NFL in that category.

injuries.shortComment: Cashman finished Sunday's loss to Detroit with 10 tackles (five solo).
injuries.longComment: Cashman was one of four Vikings to notch double-digit stops in the team's first loss of the season. The veteran linebacker has recorded at least seven stops in each of his seven games this season and has registered double-digit tackles three times. He's well beyond pace for a fourth consecutive season of triple-digit tackles, as he already has 64 stops (including 4.5 sacks) through seven contests.

injuries.shortComment: Reichard missed his sole field-goal attempt and made his sole PAT in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Reichard missed a 57-yard field goal on the first drive of the game. The kicker's miss proved costly as the Vikings lost a four-point game that went down to the wire. Reichard is now 18-for-20 on field-goal attempts and 10-for-10 on PATs through seven regular-season games in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Hockenson caught four of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-15 loss to the Lions.
injuries.longComment: Hockenson secured an eight-yard touchdown midway through the fourth quarter to give the Vikings a 15-12 lead, and he's now up to 31 grabs for 295 yards and three touchdowns on 37 targets through seven games this season. Hockenson, though, missed all but two offensive snaps in the Week 5 win over the Saints after suffering a concussion. A favorite target for Kyler Murray in the middle and short areas of the field, Hockenson has settled in as a lower-end TE1 in fantasy. He gets a plus matchup with the Bills next Monday night in another spot the Minnesota offense may be forced to push the gas pedal.

injuries.shortComment: Addison caught three of eight targets for 66 yards in Sunday's 19-15 loss to the Lions.
injuries.longComment: Addison's big play was a 51-yard catch over the top of the defense in the fourth quarter to set the offense up at the 10-yard line. T.J. Hockenson scored a go-ahead touchdown two plays later. Addison's eight targets on the day were one fewer than Justin Jefferson, but it was the former who paced the team in receiving yards. Playing in a Minnesota offense that doesn't push the ball down the field much or focus on its outside receivers, Addison has just 16 catches for 249 yards and one touchdown on 33 targets through six games this season. He'll be a fantasy WR4 with upside next Monday night against a leaky Bills secondary.

injuries.shortComment: Jones rushed five times for 22 yards and brought in both targets for 18 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Jones shook off the knee injury that had knocked him out of a Week 7 win over the Colts to head into Sunday without a designation. However, the veteran finished with a season low in carries and rushing yards. Jones has just 13 combined rush attempts -- a number partly influenced by the aforementioned early exit against Indianapolis -- in the two games since Jordan Mason returned from injured reserve, and it remains to be seen if the modest role will persist in a Week 9 home matchup against the Bills on Monday night, Nov. 9.

injuries.shortComment: Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Playing in his second game since returning from an IR stint due to a thumb injury, Mason paced the Vikings' ground attack in carries but finished two yards behind Aaron Jones, who logged five totes. Mason also wasn't targeted for the second time in three games, and Minnesota's running game figures to continue in a fantasy-averse timeshare between the two. Mason will look to make inroads against what has been an improved Bills run defense in a Week 9 home showdown on Monday night, Nov. 9.

injuries.shortComment: Kiner rushed eight times for 55 yards and a touchdown and returned nine kickoffs for 224 yards in the Patriots' 45-27 loss to the Packers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) was inactive and Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) exited the game in the second half, a pair of developments that, when paired with the blowout nature of the contest, afforded Kiner some solid run. The Cincinnati product eclipsed the 50-yard mark on the ground for the third time this season, and he finished as the team leader in rushing yards. Kiner also recorded his first career touchdown on a four-yard run with just under four minutes remaining, and he'll be in line for an expanded role in Week 10 against the Lions in Germany if neither Stevenson nor Henderson are available.

injuries.shortComment: Douglas brought in five of nine targets for 102 yards in the Patriots' 45-27 loss to the Packers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Douglas tied for the team lead in receptions and set the pace in both receiving yards and targets while serving as Drake Maye's top target in the absence of A.J. Brown (knee) and Romeo Doubs (IR, shoulder). Douglas also recorded a team-high 36-yard grab among his five catches, and both the yardage and target tallies were season highs. Douglas has at least 76 receiving yards in three of the past four games heading into a Week 10 matchup against the Lions in Germany next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Maye completed 21 of 38 passes for 299 yards with three touchdowns and three interceptions while adding one rush for three yards in the Patriots' 45-27 loss to the Packers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Maye was constantly harassed by an aggressive Packers defense that sacked him four times for 27 total yards in losses while also repeatedly getting hands on his throws. Working with a receiving corps that welcomed back Mack Hollins (calf) from injured reserve but was still down A.J. Brown (knee) and Romeo Doubs (IR, shoulder), Maye threw his first interception on the second play of the game on a deep pass intended for Hollins, and his other two picks came during the second quarter. Two of the three INTs led to Green Bay touchdowns, and after throwing just eight interceptions over 17 regular-season games in 2025, Maye is up to 11 over nine contests this season following Sunday's game. The third-year signal-caller's first chance to atone comes in a Week 10 matchup against a seemingly improving Lions defense in Munich, Germany next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Chism caught all five of his targets for 49 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Packers.
injuries.longComment: Chism was able to reel in exactly five passes for the second straight week, and he connected with quarterback Drake Maye for an eight-yard touchdown in the second quarter. The score was Chism's second of the year and first since Week 4. With A.J. Brown (knee) potentially set to miss the team's Week 10 matchup against the Lions, Chism may have a chance to operate in a prominent role again against Detroit's underwhelming secondary.

injuries.shortComment: Henry caught all three of his targets for 35 yards during Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Packers.
injuries.longComment: Henry returned to action after suffering a foot injury in the first half and missing the majority of the team's Week 8 win over the Dolphins. The tight end was held in check versus Green Bay, finishing with three or fewer catches for the sixth time this season. Henry has now reeled in 32 of 37 targets for 361 yards and two touchdowns over nine contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Brown (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's contest against the Packers.
injuries.longComment: Brown sustained a knee injury in the first half, and he will now officially not return to the contest. If he is forced to miss any action moving forward, Walter Rouse is a top candidate to start in Brown's place at offensive guard.

injuries.shortComment: Schooler (hamstring) will not return to Sunday's game against the Packers.
injuries.longComment: Strictly a special-teamer for New England, Schooler entered play Sunday with four tackles (two solo) across four games this season. His next chance to play will be next Sunday in Detroit.

injuries.shortComment: Campbell (knee) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against the Packers.
injuries.longComment: Campbell suffered a knee injury in the second half, and he seems unlikely to be able to return before the conclusion of the team's Week 9 contest. In his absence, Caleb Lomu has taken over at left tackle versus Green Bay.

injuries.shortComment: Stevenson headed to the locker room during Sunday's game against the Packers to be evaluated for an unspecified issue, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Before that, Stevenson carried six times for 32 yards and caught three of his four targets for 46 yards and a TD. With TreVeyon Henderson (illness) sidelined for an undetermined amount of time, Corey Kiner and Lan Larison are available to handle New England's backfield duties Sunday for as long as Stevenson is out of the game.

injuries.shortComment: Davis (knee) is questionable to return to New England's matchup Sunday versus the Packers.
injuries.longComment: Davis is in danger of missing the remainder of the game after suffering a knee injury in the second half. Channing Canada and Karon Prunty could be in line for an uptick in playing time if Davis is unable to return to the matchup.

injuries.shortComment: Morton (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Patriots' emergency third quarterback against the Packers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: As the emergency third quarterback, Morton is not allowed to play Sunday unless both Drake Maye and Tommy DeVito are removed from the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuries.shortComment: Hollins (calf) is listed as active for Sunday's game against the Packers.
injuries.longComment: Hollins, who had landed on IR prior to Week 5 action, was activated from IR/designated to return Saturday but still carried a 'questionable' designation ahead of the contest. In his first game action since Week 4, Hollins could make an immediate contribution to a WR corps that also includes DeMario Douglas, Efton Chism and Kyle Williams, but remains without A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) and Romeo Doubs (IR, shoulder). Prior to his injury, Hollins recorded a 15/209/0 receiving line on 20 targets through four games.
